relationship_types.A_documented_transmission: A cultural/religious tradition demonstrably moves between regions.
relationship_types.B_localization_adaptation: A transmitted element is retained but renamed/reinterpreted/visually transformed.
relationship_types.C_syncretism_religious_integration: Elements from multiple traditions combine into a new local form.
relationship_types.D_parallel_motif_convergent_similarity: Two traditions share a structural idea without evidence one derived from the other.
relationship_types.E_contested_or_uncertain_relationship: A proposed link exists in popular discourse but evidence is incomplete/disputed.
relationship_types.F_false_friend_superficial_resemblance: Two items look similar but are unrelated in meaning, function, chronology, or origin.
